_comment: Example MCP registration for Claude Code. Merge the 'mcpServers' entry below into your Claude Code MCP config (e.g. `claude mcp add-json kaliai-recon '{...}'` or the equivalent in .claude/settings.json). kaliai agent already exports KALIAI_ENGAGEMENT / KALIAI_ENGAGEMENT_DIR before launching the agent, so the server inherits them — no extra env config needed when launched via `kaliai agent`.
